d: Long, sandy-blonde hair with straight bangs and two long side-locks is styled with a small cowlick on top. Bright reddish-brown eyes have a wide, cheerful expression on a youthful face with a petite build. The outfit is a dark navy sailor-style school uniform featuring a white collar with red trim and a large red neckerchief. A dark navy strap crosses the torso diagonally over the chest.
